# Yichen Container House

> > Leading Chinese manufacturer and wholesale supplier of prefab, modular, and custom container homes with ISO certification and global shipping capabilities.

Yichen Container House is a China-based supplier specializing in innovative container housing solutions including the Apple Cabin product line. The company offers wholesale, prefab, modular, and fully customizable container homes with OEM/ODM support, serving markets across Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and internationally from their headquarters in Liaocheng City, Shandong Province.

## Container House Types

- [20FT Container House](https://yccontainerhouse.com/container-options/20ft-container-house): 20ft container house product page with specifications for prefab and modular housing.
- [40 Foot Container House](https://yccontainerhouse.com/container-options/40-foot-container-house): ISO-certified 40-foot container house with pricing from $11,800 and quick installation.
- [Small Container House](https://yccontainerhouse.com/container-options/small-container-house): Small container house product page highlighting durability, low maintenance, and shipping benefits.
- [Container Tiny House](https://yccontainerhouse.com/container-options/container-tiny-house): Tiny house containers offering durable, low-maintenance, and affordable housing solutions.
- [Expandable Container House](https://yccontainerhouse.com/container-options/expandable-container-house): Expandable container house with smart modular designs and solar energy housing options.
- [Folding Container House](https://yccontainerhouse.com/container-options/folding-container-house): Foldable and portable container homes from Yichen with quick deployment and cost-effective solutions.
- [Flat Pack Container House](https://yccontainerhouse.com/container-options/flat-pack-container-house): Flat-pack container houses with quick assembly, solar options, and OEM/ODM manufacturing support.
